item.title: Introduction to Neural Networks
item.description: An overview of neural network fundamentals
item.content:encoded:
Overview

This presentation introduces the fundamental concepts of neural networks, exploring how they learn from data and make predictions.

Key Topics Covered

1. Perceptrons

The building blocks of neural networks.

2. Activation Functions

  • Sigmoid
  • ReLU
  • Tanh
  • Softmax

3. Backpropagation

The algorithm that enables neural networks to learn.

Results

Our simple network achieved 95% accuracy on the MNIST test set.

References

  • Goodfellow, I., Bengio, Y., & Courville, A. (2016). Deep Learning. MIT Press.
